An '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living with his daughter [[Mila Escalus]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A descendant of a man who was entrusted by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Aloysius Kallig]] with his [[Kallig's lightsaber|lightsaber]] for safekeeping, Escalus bet the lightsaber along with everything he had against a known [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] cheaper [[Gyl Rosen]], losing it in the process.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mila Escalus's father is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Nar Shaddaa.
